items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [リスボン　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[リスボン　２０日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのペレイラ・ポルトガル中銀総裁は２０日、エネルギー高に伴うインフレ圧力が強まる中、天然ガス価格の高騰が金融当局者の間では特に「懸念材料」となっているとの見方を示した。

ペレイラ氏はポルトガル経済紙が主催した会議で、エネルギー高がユーロ圏経済全般に波及しているかどうかは不明とした上で「二次的な影響をもたらすかどうかが大きな問題だ」と述べた。

ペレイラ氏は、輸送の要衝ホルムズ海峡でタンカー航行の混乱が続く中、海峡再開に関する不確実性を挙げ、石油や天然ガス、精製品などエネルギー製品の価格上昇を指摘。北欧諸国の一部で天然ガスの貯蔵が低水準となっており「厳冬となれば貯蔵不足に陥り、電力価格に上昇圧力がかかる可能性がある」と説明した。

ユーロ圏の１０月の消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）は前年同月比４．０％上昇し、３年ぶりの高水準となった。エネルギー価格の上昇が響き、伸び率はＥＣＢが目標とする２％の２倍の水準で推移している。

items.body:
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２０日、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの創業者の一人が、今後数週間以内に新生児向け投資口座「トランプ口座」に多額の寄付を行う予定だと明らかにした。

ベセント長官はＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで、「優れた起業家らが自らの富を分かち合うことは 重要だと考えている」と述べた。

アンソロピックは１９日にナスダック市場へ新規上場し、時価総額は一時約２兆ドルに達した。新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）では約８１０億ドルを調達した。主幹事証券会社による追加株式購入オプション（グリーンシュー・オプション）が全額行使された場合、調達額は最大９３５億ドルとなり、過去最大のＩＰＯとなる。

トランプ口座は大型減税・歳出法に基づき創設された制度で、２０２５─２８年に生まれる米国市民が対象。これまでに起業家マイケル・デル氏や著名投資家レイ・ダリオ氏らが拠出を表明している。

Maresca shrugs off links between Man City's slump and financial case

FAST

Nov 20 : Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca has dismissed suggestions that uncertainty over the club's possible punishment for breaches of Premier League financial rules is behind his side's recent slump in form.
City opened the season with seven successive league victories but head into Saturday's home clash with Fulham on the back of three straight defeats before the international break, leaving them third in the table, six points behind Arsenal.
An independent commission in September found City guilty of 114 of the 115 financial charges brought by the Premier League. The club have denied wrongdoing and are appealing against the verdict.
No sanction has yet been imposed but a substantial points deduction could even result in relegation, prompting questions over whether the off-field uncertainty has affected the players.

"I don't think the players are thinking too much about that," Maresca told a press conference on Friday.
"If we want to relate the noise with the defeat, (Aston) Villa away we had so many chances - for instance, Iliman (Ndiaye) hit the post - Brighton their keeper was man of the match, at (Nottingham) Forest where Erling (Haaland) had the chance to score (to make it) 2-2.
"I don't think the players are focused on the noise."
Even without any potential punishment, City are already in danger of losing touch with champions Arsenal who have won nine of their opening 10 games.
NO NEED TO PANIC
Maresca, however, is not about to panic and rip up the script, insisting there is not much difference between the side that opened the season in superb fashion and the one that has suffered three defeats on the spin.
"This morning they told me that we played 16 official games and we won 12... So, if in the next 16 games, you say to me that we are going to win 12, I'll sign," he said.
"I was not thinking we were doing everything well when we were winning games. I'm not thinking we did everything wrong when we lost games," the Italian said.
Improving a defence that has leaked eight goals in the last four league games is a priority though.
"We also need to analyse the defeats. Aston Villa and Brighton, in both games man of the match was the keeper for them. At Forest we were not good enough, particularly in the first half," Maresca said.
"We are conceding too many goals. Most of them are avoidable. The idea is to continue to attack in the same way, creating chances, but creating a balance when we defend."
City will be boosted by the availability of defender Marc Guehi who, according to Maresca, missed England's Nations League games because of a "small issue".

Source: Reuters

[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２０日、イランから脅迫を受けたため、引き続き米軍基地に居住していると明らかにした。その上で、イランに対する経済的な締め付けを続ける意向を表明した。脅迫の内容は不明。

米国とイスラエルは２月にイランへの攻撃を開始。財務省はイランへの制裁を強化してきた。

items.body:
Niket Nishant

[２０日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの株価が２０日午前の取引で１０％超下落した。１９日にＡＩブームの持続性を占う試金石として注目されたナスダック上場を果たしたものの、ＡＩ業界を巡る先行き懸念を払拭するには至らず、ハイテク株全体に売りが広がっている。

直近の取引でアンソロピック株は８６．４５ドル前後で推移。１９日の取引では初値が１１１．５ドルと、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の８３ドルを約３４％上回った。その後は上げ幅を縮小し、終値は１７％高の９７．１７ドルだった。

カタリスト・ファンドのデービッド・ミラー最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「投資家は引き続きＡＩを信じているが、その成長にどの程度の対価を支払うべきかについては、より選別的になりつつある」と述べた。

半導体大手エヌビディアも約６％下落した。時価総額は約３兆４０００億ドルに縮小し、グーグル親会社アルファベット に抜かれ、米企業の時価総額ランキングで４位に後退した。

その他の大型ハイテク株も軟調で、メタ＜META.O＞は３％超安、アマゾン・ドット・コム＜AMZN.O＞は２％安、マイクロソフト＜MSFT.O＞は１％安。半導体株も売られ、ＡＭＤ＜AMD.O＞とサンディスク＜SNDK.O＞はそれぞれ６％超、インテル＜INTC.O＞は３％超下落した。

ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合は約２．７％安で推移した。

＜忍耐必要も＞

ただ、アンソロピック株は年内に下支えされる可能性もある。

指数リバランス分析会社イントロピックは、指数連動型ファンドによるパッシブ需要を背景に、２０２６年末までに売り出し株式の最大３０％が買われると推計している。

ＵＳバンク・アセット・マネジメントのプライベートマーケット投資部門責任者カウシュ・アミン氏は、アンソロピックの現在の評価額について「数年にわたる急速な成長を見込んでいる」と指摘。「忍耐強い姿勢を保ち、決算発表のたびに評価を見直すことを推奨する」と述べた。

＜スペースＸとの比較＞

アンソロピックはＩＰＯで約８１０億ドルを調達し、６月に上場した米宇宙企業スペースＸの７５０億ドルを上回る過去最大規模の案件となった。

スペースＸ株が上場後数週間にわたり大きく変動したことを踏まえ、一部投資家はアンソロピック株への早期投資に慎重な見方を示している。

ＲＦラファティのロブ・ハッケル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、「スペースＸと同様に一定のボラティリティーが予想される。多くの投資家が『乗り遅れ恐怖症（ＦＯＭＯ）』に駆られるだろうが、初日の取引で飛びつく必要は全くないと思う」と述べた。

スペースＸ株も２０日の取引で約６％下落した。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 20 : A founder of the artificial intelligence giant Anthropic will make a large gift to cradle-to-adulthood investment program, Trump Accounts, in the coming weeks, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in an interview with CNBC on Friday.
Anthropic raised $93.5 billion in its blockbuster IPO on Thursday after underwriters exercised an option to buy additional shares
"One of the Anthropic founders is going to make a large gift to Trump Accounts over the next few weeks," Bessent said. "We believe that it's important for these great entrepreneurs to share their bounty."
Trump Accounts, which will provide U.S. citizens born between 2025 and 2028 a government-funded investment account of $1,000 that families can build on, is aimed at promoting investing and financial literacy from an early age.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 英ＥＵが首脳会合、食品貿易や若者交流で合意　大学授業料巡る協議は先送り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Philip Blenkinsop　Alistair Smout

[ブリュッセル　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Philip Blenkinsop　Alistair Smout

[ブリュッセル　２０日　ロイター] - 英国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）は２０日の首脳会合で、食品貿易の円滑化や若者の交流促進に関する合意をまとめ、関係の再構築に向けた一歩を踏み出した。一方、大学の授業料に関する合意は先送りされ、長期的な関係についてはより広範な議論に委ねる格好となった。 

英国が、現在２７カ国からなるＥＵからの離脱を国民投票で決定してから１０年が経過する。相互のわだかまりは薄れており、ロシアによるウクライナへの全面侵攻、米国の関税措置、重要鉱物のサプライチェーン（供給網）における中国の支配、イラン戦争などを受けた世界秩序の再編を背景に、双方はより緊密な連携の必要性を認識している。 

バーナム英首相は首脳会合後の記者会見で「英国にとっても欧州にとっても、きょうが良い日であることは誰もが自信を持って言えるだろう」と述べ、「われわれが共にまとめた合意はウィンウィンだ」と述べた。

両者は首脳会合で、食品検査、若者の移動、排出量取引制度に関する合意をまとめた。ただ、ＥＵが引き下げを求める中、英国が抵抗してきた大学授業料の引き下げに関する合意は６カ月先送りした。

今回の最も重要な合意は、ソーセージや種子といった動物・植物およびその関連製品の越境貿易について、現在求められている証明書や検査を不要とするものだ、英政府はこれにより、経済効果が年間最大５１億ポンド（６７億ドル）に上る可能性があると試算している。

バーナム氏は、英国はＥＵ再加盟を含め、将来の関係に関する選択肢を検討すべきだと主張してきた。１６日には、英国がＥＵ離脱により得たものより失ったものの方が多いのは「明白な事実」だと述べていた。 

＜将来に向けたブレーンストーミング＞ 

バーナム氏は、次に何を達成できるかについて、約１年後にＥＵと非公式の意見交換を行うことを想定していると語った。

フォンデアライエン欧州委員長は、ＥＵとの将来の関係について幅広く議論しようとするバーナム氏の姿勢を歓迎すると表明。「われわれは意見交換に前向きで、これを歓迎する。われわれを頼りにしてほしい」と述べた。

コスタＥＵ大統領は、ＥＵは「可能な限り緊密な関係」に前向きだと語った。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２０日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）に対し、一部の理事が支持しているような大幅な利上げを採用しないよう促した。エネルギーの供給ショックと原油価格の下落を理由に挙げた。

ベセント氏はＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで、０．５０％ポイントの利上げを支持しているある理事が、この１年以内に同幅の利下げを求めていたと指摘。「わずか１２カ月、あるいは１１カ月後の今になって、より大幅な利上げを求めるのは、方針がやや揺れているように見える」と指摘した。

その上で、「ＦＲＢには過去ではなく、先行きに目を向けるよう促したい」と語った。

items.title: Indian investors show strong appetite for Anthropic's blockbuster IPO
items.author: Kairavi Lukka
items.summary: Indian investors flocked to Anthropic shares on its US market debut, with the AI company ranking among the most-traded stocks on platforms such as INDmoney and Vested.
items.body: Indian investors have shown a strong appetite for Anthropic’s blockbuster initial public offering (IPO). The artificial intelligence (AI) company emerged as one of the most actively traded US stocks on Indian investment platforms on its market debut. Trading activity on platforms such as INDmoney and Vested indicated significant retail interest in the listing, as investors looked to gain exposure to the AI boom. Anthropic’s IPO, which raised $81.3 billion at a valuation of $1.5 trillion, is the largest public offering globally so far. On INDmoney, Anthropic accounted for 40 per cent of all platform activity on Thursday, with average trade values nearly twice the platform average, said Ashish Kashyap, founder. He added that the listing attracted investors across professions, including engineering, finance and media, many of whom were already users of the company’s Claude AI products. “Anthropic’s listing saw unprecedented demand, driven largely by Claude users,” Kashyap said.  He added that the broader AI theme continued to attract strong investor interest. On Vested, Anthropic accounted for around 11 per cent of the total traded value and 9 per cent of all trades on the platform during the session. A spokesperson from the firm said nearly 84 per cent of the trades in the stock were placed within the first two hours of trading. It was the platform’s second-most traded stock by value, behind AMD and ahead of Nvidia. Anthropic was traded seven times more than Nvidia during the session. The average buy order on Vested was around $1,100, while nearly 20 per cent of the platform’s active traders on Thursday bought Anthropic shares. For some investors, the appeal was rooted in their familiarity with the product rather than just the IPO buzz.  An Indian-origin investor based in the US, who applied for shares worth over $130,000 but received an allocation of less than 5 per cent of what he applied for, said he invested despite the recent fall in AI stocks. This is due to the buzz around it and the long-term value that it generates. “I bought Anthropic because I use it in my day-to-day life, and it's pretty useful for automating work and saving time. It enables me to generate more output than I ever could in a short span,” he said.  Tanvi Kanchan, associate director at Anand Rathi Share & Stock Brokers, said that he saw a sharp rise in client enquiries around Anthropic's listing, well above what he typically sees for a US IPO. For many Indian investors, it was the first chance to own a leading AI model company directly. Shares of Anthropic ended at $97.17 apiece on Thursday against its issue price of $83.
items.raw_description: Indian investors flocked to Anthropic shares on its US market debut, with the AI company ranking among the most-traded stocks on platforms such as INDmoney and Vested.

items.title: エヌビディア、米時価総額4位に後退　7週連続下落へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２０日 ロイター] - ２０日午前の米株式市場で、米半導体大手エヌビディア
items.body:
[２０日 ロイター] - ２０日午前の米株式市場で、米半導体大手エヌビディア の時価総額がグーグルの親会社である米アルファベットを下回り、米企業４位に後退した。同社株の売りが長引き、時価総額上位の順位が入れ替わった。

エヌビディア株は直近で３％下落し、時価総額は３兆４０００億ドルとなった。週間では７週連続で下落する見通しで、２００８年以来の長期下落局面となっている。

時価総額順位の低下は、ＡＩ関連銘柄について投資家の選好が変化していることも浮き彫りにしている。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、ＡＩ関連投資の動向に左右されにくいと見られるアップルは、時価総額５兆０８００億ドルで引き続き他社を大きく引き離している。マイクロソフトが３兆７２００億ドルで２位、アルファベットが３兆４４００億ドルで３位となった。

FAST

MANCHESTER, England, Nov 20 : Mauricio Pochettino pledged to rebuild Manchester United "from scratch" and urged his players to forget the club's troubled recent past ahead of a daunting first assignment at Liverpool on Sunday.
The Argentine, appointed after United's difficult start to the season led to Michael Carrick's sacking, struck an upbeat tone on Friday in his first press conference as manager, saying his focus was firmly on establishing a new identity rather than dwelling on previous failures.
"We arrive with the idea to create something from scratch, from our own ideas and philosophy in the way that we love to work," Pochettino said, glancing at assistant coach Jesus Perez who attended the press conference.
"It is about building our own way here. The past is not going to help, to think about yesterday.

"We feel the support and we are going to work really hard to help the players to perform. That is the priority."
Pochettino's first days in the job have been hectic. He left the United States in the early hours of Wednesday and began meetings with players and staff immediately.
Asked about his initial objective, he smiled and said "sleep".
SCALE OF THE TASK
There will be little time for rest, however, with United travelling to Anfield to face Liverpool.
The trip offers an immediate measure of the scale of the task confronting Pochettino as he attempts to revive a side whose confidence has been eroded by poor results. United are languishing in 18th in their worst start to a top-flight campaign in 40 years.
"It is normal when you don't win games that the confidence starts to go down," he said. "I think the players need to feel from us that we believe and trust in them.
"With the schedule we have ahead we have to settle on our principles. The players are intelligent, they have quality. Sometimes it is unlocking some things that didn't appear for different reasons."
A key figure in any rebuilding effort will be captain Bruno Fernandes, whose future has been the subject of speculation as he has yet to agree a new deal.
Pochettino revealed he had already held extensive talks with the Portugal midfielder and indicated he remained central to his plans.
"Bruno is our captain and a very important player but other players have to feel they are important from the bottom to the top," he said.
"We spoke (on Thursday), I spent three hours chatting with all the players individually. It was very nice contact."
FITNESS AND RECRUITMENT
Questions about the squad's fitness levels have swirled around Old Trafford, but Pochettino refused to criticise what he had inherited.
"It is about proposing that idea to be brave and take it to the field," he said.
"We cannot talk about data without context. It is easy to manipulate data but we need to be honest, sometimes they don't show something that you can see on the field.
"We are here not to denounce things. We are here to build something with our players."
Pochettino also made clear he expects to have a voice in recruitment and wider football matters, while accepting responsibility for results.
"I was in all my career a coach, head coach, manager. It does not change too much," he said. "I know as head coach I am the guy who tomorrow will decide the squad for Sunday, pick the 11, make the changes.
"I know in the future I would like to be involved in all the main decisions that affect the squad."
Pochettino said he relished returning to the daily routine of club football after he led the Americans to the 2025 Gold Cup final and steered them to the last 16 of the World Cup this year on home soil.
"We were missing it a lot," he said of club football. "We are animals of the grass, we like to feel the grass, to smell the grass, improve players every day."

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 20 : Nvidia, the centerpiece of Wall Street's AI trade, slipped behind Google parent Alphabet to become the fourth-most valuable US company on Friday, as a prolonged selloff in the chipmaker's shares reshuffled the top of the market-value rankings.
The stock, last down 3 per cent and valued at $3.4 trillion, was on course for a seventh straight weekly decline, its longest losing streak since 2008.
The slide comes days after Nvidia's first earnings report since co-founder Jensen Huang's resignation, which failed to ease investor concerns about leadership and the durability of AI spending.
Nvidia's fall down the market-value rankings also underscores a shift within the AI trade, as investors gravitate toward companies that pair heavy AI investment with established cloud and software revenue streams.
Apple, seen as less exposed to the AI trade, remained well ahead with a market value of $5.08 trillion. Microsoft ranked second at $3.72 trillion, followed by Alphabet at $3.44 trillion, according to LSEG data.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米下院司法委次期委員長、法執行機関に記録保全要請　アプリの通信内容も対象
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Susan Heavey

[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Susan Heavey

[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] - 米下院司法委員会の次期委員長に就任する見通しのジェイミー・ラスキン議員（民主党）は２０日、トランプ政権の司法省および国土安全保障省の高官らに書簡を送り、通信アプリ「シグナル」やその他のアプリ上の電子メッセージを含む全ての記録を保全するよう求めた。

ラスキン氏は、来年１月に民主党が議会の主導権を握った際には、同委員会を率い、一連の調査を次々と開始する見通しだ。同氏は書簡で、不適切に削除された通信記録があれば、その復元を試みるよう連邦法執行機関に警告した。

さらに「トランプ政権の高官らが、連邦の記録保全法を回避する明確な目的で、政府記録の広範な破棄、損壊、隠蔽に関与してきたことを示す重要な証拠がある」と指摘。「この透明性を回避しようとする試みは、法執行機関の最高幹部を含め、連邦機関の最高レベルにまで及んでいる」と述べた。

書簡は、ブランチ司法長官やマークウェイン・マリン国土安全保障長官のほか、連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）、連邦刑務所局、移民・関税執行局（ＩＣＥ）の各機関トップ宛てに送られた。ラスキン氏は５つの機関・省庁に対し、１２月３日までに応じるよう求めた。 

これに対し、司法省報道官は「司法省は、公務上の機能や決定に関わる連邦記録の管理について、全ての法的要件に従っている」とした上で、職員が「威圧されることはない」と述べた。 

連邦法は、米政府機関に対し、公的な政府業務に関する記録の保全を義務付けており、議会は行政府に対する監督権限を持つ。

国土安全保障省、ＦＢＩ、連邦刑務所局、ＩＣＥの担当者はコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

FAST

LAS VEGAS, Nov 20 : Formula One stakeholders have agreed in principle a switch away from the current crop of V6 hybrid engines to louder V8s from 2030, team bosses said ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
McLaren's Zak Brown said it was now a matter of dotting the i's and crossing the t's, and Alpine's de facto team principal Flavio Briatore agreed.
"We have the agreement, basically. It's not signed, but it looks like everybody's agreed to 2030 V8s," said Italian Briatore.
"I think it's the right way to go. We need an engine with a lot of noise, and a simple engine, and we need to be racing with that because, in the end, I believe the best for the spectator, for everybody is a very simple engine, a lot of noise and basta (enough)."

McLaren and Alpine both use Mercedes engines.
Cadillac's Dan Towriss said he was also happy with developments, with the team set to continue using Ferrari engines until the end of 2029 and a Cadillac V8 engine available from 2030.
"Our new power unit facility opens up on December 18th, so as a new manufacturer coming into the sport, the direction is obviously very helpful," he added.
FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem signalled this week that the V8s would be back for 2030. Formula One last used naturally aspirated V8 engines from 2006 to 2013.

items.title: サウジ主導連合、紅海の要衝ホデイダ港を攻撃　フーシ派は報復警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yasmine Ghania　Muhammad Al Gebaly

[２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Yasmine Ghania　Muhammad Al Gebaly

[２０日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派と戦うサウジアラビア主導の連合軍は２０日、フーシ派の戦闘能力を破壊するため、紅海の要衝ホデイダ港を攻撃したと発表した。一方、フーシ派は数時間以内に新たな空爆を行うと表明し、航空各社にサウジ領空を避けるよう警告した。

ホデイダ港は、フーシ派が支配するイエメン北部に食料などの物資を搬入する主要港。連合軍は、武器や弾道ミサイルの輸送に使われていた同港の機能を破壊したと説明した。これに先立ち、民間人に周辺地域から避難するよう警告していた。

ただイエメン情報相によると、港は引き続き全面的に稼働しており、物資の搬入も継続しているという。

フーシ派は、サウジが警告通りホデイダ港を攻撃すれば、紅海沿岸のサウジの港湾を攻撃すると表明していた。

フーシ派のヤヒヤ・サリー軍事報道官は声明で「（サウジの紅海沿岸の）港湾の全ての職員、労働者、周辺にいる人々に対し、直ちに避難し、近づかないよう警告する。全ての海運会社にも、これらの港から船舶を直ちに退避させるよう求める」と表明した。

サリー氏はさらに、サウジ領空が「今後数時間のうちにわれわれの作戦の舞台となる」として、航空各社に飛行を避けるよう求めた。ただ、イスラム教の聖地メッカとメディナ周辺の空域は除外した。また、サウジ南部シュカイクの発電所を標的にすると表明した。

一方、連合軍は、イエメンの首都サヌアで弾道ミサイルと無人機の運用機能を標的とする作戦を実施したと発表。サアダとタイズでも作戦を継続しているとした。

対イラン戦争と並行して７月にイエメンで戦闘が再開して以来、フーシ派は急速に進撃し、サウジが支援する国際承認政府とその同盟勢力から支配地域を奪っている。

FAST

Nov 20 : Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola wants his side to be prepared for surprises when Manchester United, under new boss Mauricio Pochettino, visit Anfield in the Premier League on Sunday.
United, a lowly 18th in the table, are winless in the league since August, but Iraola believes the rivalry with Liverpool and the arrival of a new manager could breathe new life into their lacklustre campaign.
"We have to acknowledge the importance of the game... they have a new manager, new challenges for us," Iraola told a press conference on Friday.
"It's true that they have this small advantage, we don't have references to prepare, because they can go different ways that we honestly don't know right now."

Iraola said United's players would try to impress the new manager and that Liverpool would have to deal with that early in the game.
"The beginning of the game will be important... we know their players very well, who they are, the strengths and weaknesses they have shown," the Spaniard said.
Liverpool are fourth in the league and have won six of their last eight matches in all competitions, including their penalty shootout victory over Chelsea in the League Cup. Their home form continues to bother Iraola, however, with the team winning only one of their five league games at Anfield.
United have not lost to rivals Liverpool since September 2024, and they have not been beaten at Anfield since a famous 7-0 thrashing by Juergen Klopp's side in March 2023.
"Yes, I think we are conscious our away stats are much better. We need to improve this and United is the first chance," Iraola said.
Liverpool will be boosted by the return of injured trio Jeremie Frimpong, Ryan Gravenberch and Virgil van Dijk, who should be available for Sunday's match. Giovanni Leoni and Conor Bradley have returned to training but are not yet available, Iraola added.
IRAOLA CONDEMNS DRONE FILMING
Iraola said he had been sent the training footage of United that a drone operator filmed this week and posted on his YouTube channel. The operator has since apologised and taken down the footage.
"Yesterday they were sending me the footage. But the important part of this is, it shouldn't be legal. It happened to United but it could happen to me, to any training," Iraola said.
"It's not a matter of advantage, it's the fact that someone can do this. There is a reason we train behind closed doors... I don't think it's nice for any club."

Source: Reuters

TURIN, Italy, Nov 20 : Seven-times Grand Slam champion Carlos Alcaraz eased concerns about a hamstring injury by cruising past Italian fifth seed Flavio Cobolli 6-4 6-1 in his final ATP Finals round-robin match in Turin on Friday, completing an unbeaten group-stage campaign and securing momentum ahead of the semi-finals.
The Spaniard had already booked his place in the last four after victories over American seventh seed Frances Tiafoe and 2020 ATP Finals champion Daniil Medvedev, but his fitness came under scrutiny after he left the court with heavy strapping on his left leg following Wednesday's win over the Russian.
Any doubts were quickly dispelled as Alcaraz broke the already-eliminated Cobolli in the opening game and surged into a 2-0 lead. The 23-year-old delivered an efficient display, keeping rallies short and dictating play without putting unnecessary strain on his body.
He carried that momentum into the second set, breaking for a 2-0 lead and again to move 4-1 ahead before closing out a 65-minute victory. Alcaraz finished with 29 winners to Cobolli's nine.

"It was a difficult match to see how I was going to feel on court and playing against Flavio is not easy," Alcaraz said. "He is a great player and person off the court.
"I tried to play as aggressively as I can, hit the ball as hard as I can.
"The way I felt on court today was incredible. I am getting more confident after every match and hopefully I can keep it going."
Alcaraz underwent an MRI scan on his left hamstring on Thursday, with Spanish media reporting that the examination ruled out a serious injury. He also cancelled a practice session that day and delayed his scheduled warm-up from 1045 to 1300 local time earlier on Friday.
While the convincing win eased immediate concerns over his availability for the knockout stage, the defending Australian Open champion will continue to manage the issue as the season-ending tournament reaches its decisive phase.
Alcaraz is enjoying a resurgent end to the year after spending more than four months sidelined with a wrist injury sustained at the ATP 500 event in Barcelona.
Since returning at the US Open in September, where he was beaten by Ben Shelton in the quarter-finals, Alcaraz has claimed titles in Tokyo, Vienna and Paris to re-establish himself among the favourites for the season-ending crown.
With three wins from three in the Ivan Lendl group, Alcaraz heads into the semi-final against American third seed Shelton in strong form as he bids to capture his first ATP Finals title.
Five-times Grand Slam champion Jannik Sinner has already ended his season because of a persistent knee injury, while world number one Alexander Zverev remains among the leading contenders in Turin.

items.title: Sebi proposes removing additional disclosure framework for FPIs
items.author: Khushboo Tiwari
items.summary: The regulator seeks to ease compliance for foreign portfolio investors by removing granular beneficial ownership disclosures introduced in 2023, citing global competitiveness concerns.
items.body: In a bid to attract more foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) to India, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on Friday proposed removing the Additional Disclosure Framework (ADF) for such overseas investors, which was introduced in August 2023 for granular disclosure on ultimate beneficial owners. This comes against the backdrop of large FPI outflows which have exerted severe pressure on the foreign exchange market and the value of the Indian rupee. Sebi noted that such disclosure requirements may act as “entry barriers” for FPIs and need to be weighed against the prevailing requirements in other jurisdictions “competing for the same pool of global monies”. “The granular disclosure requirements under ADF have been prescribed by Sebi over and above the BO (beneficial owners) identification requirements specified under PMLR (Prevention of Money Laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005). Further, such granular disclosure requirements under the ADF are unique to India,” the regulator noted. Under the current requirements, if FPIs meet specified concentration or size criteria, they are mandated to submit granular details of all entities holding any ownership, economic interest or exercising control — on a full look-through basis upto all natural persons without any thresholds. These include FPIs that hold more than 50 per cent of their Indian equity assets under management (AUM) in a single corporate group, or those whose individual or combined holdings with their investor group exceed ₹50,000 crore in Indian equity markets. The threshold was raised from ₹25,000 crore to ₹50,000 crore in April 2025. However, exemptions were provided to certain broad-based, pooled funds with diversified investor bases and those with government or government-related ownership, subject to specified conditions.  Under PMLR, the threshold for controlling ownership is 10 per cent and 15 per cent depending on the legal form of the client — thresholds also applicable to FPIs. Sebi added that several developed markets follow a 25 per cent threshold with lower thresholds only for high-risk entities. “Thus, going by global standards, India follows a more stringent regime for identification of BOs. There may be a need to review the PMLR, 2005 to make it consistent with other jurisdictions. However, this is under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance,” noted Sebi. FPIs have been net sellers in the Indian equity markets for a sustained period starting late 2024 — accelerating in the subsequent years, Sebi noted. It added that while there could have been several factors behind FPI outflows, the “relatively onerous rules” on identification and disclosure of BOs compared to other countries necessitated a review.   “Many foreign investors looking to invest in India consider the granular disclosure requirements as an additional compliance burden. Rather than investing in India and be subject to granular disclosures, many investors may instead choose to avoid investing in India,” noted Sebi. The additional disclosure framework came months after the now defunct Hindenburg Research levelled allegations of violations of minimum public shareholding and stock manipulation against the Adani group — which were denied by the ports-to- retail conglomerate. In its discussions with the FPIs, Sebi noted some of the challenges raised by overseas investors included collecting information from a significantly larger number of underlying investors for India specific investments, requirement to set up different fund for India investments owing to different compliance levels, frequent change in investor holdings in pooled vehicles such as hedge funds, and difficulty in tracing ownership in structures such as fund of funds. “Disclosure requirements that are not in line with globally accepted practices could potentially place India at a competitive disadvantage vis-à-vis peer jurisdictions with relatively lenient regulatory requirements,” noted the paper.

FAST

Nov 19 : Bertelsmann has no plan to enter the video games market despite the blockbuster success of "Grand Theft Auto VI," said Thomas Rabe, CEO of the German media group that published the original game in the franchise.
Huge global demand for GTA VI is expected to generate revenue far exceeding its estimated development costs of around $1 billion.
But "not every game becomes as successful as GTA," Rabe said and cautioned that gaming remains a hit-driven business, similar to the film industry. "New games are not easy to establish."
Bertelsmann's BMG Interactive division published the first "Grand Theft Auto" in 1997. The next year, the company sold the business to Take-Two Interactive, which went on to develop one of the world's most successful gaming franchises.
Rabe said his company has repeatedly examined entering the gaming market over the past 10 to 15 years, but decided against it. He cited high acquisition costs, reputational risks and the industry's reliance on a few blockbusters.
Bertelsmann, whose businesses include broadcaster RTL Group, publisher Penguin Random House, music company BMG and logistics provider Arvato, sees little need to expand into other sectors, Rabe said.

Source: Reuters

SANTIAGO, Nov 20 : Chile will seek to strengthen cooperation with Japan on critical minerals to ensure resilience and stability in supply chains, Chilean President Jose Antonio Kast said on Friday.
• "We are committed to strengthening cooperation on critical minerals, including copper," Kast said after meeting Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi during an official visit to Japan
• Chile is the world's largest copper producer and second-largest lithium producer. Both metals are key to electric vehicles and battery energy storage systems
• The cooperation will "contribute to the resilience and stability of global supply chains by ensuring that trade measures are consistent with relevant international agreements", a joint statement added

FAST

Nov 20 : South Africa captain Siya Kolisi hit back at a suggestion Springbok coach Rassie Erasmus was being "dramatic" in saying the side had let the country down in defeat by France as the team vowed they would not be sidetracked by the latter's suspension.
Erasmus made the statement on Monday in announcing his team for the Nations Championship clash with Ireland in Dublin on Saturday, the same press conference from which he received a six-match ban from World Rugby for criticising the match officials in Paris.
Kolisi was asked if the coach was being dramatic with the statement, a suggestion which clearly riled the Springbok captain.
"Did you say it was dramatic?" he asked twice. "It might sound dramatic to you, but to us it means so much more. Rugby has done a lot for our country, and it's done a lot for many of us who come from South Africa," Kolisi said.

"We know how happy people are and what the mood is like when we win, and when we lose, it gets tough. People care a lot about it.
"When we play, we think about the people back home. We don't take representing the country lightly because we represent every single person in South Africa when we put on that jersey."
Ireland have selected regular hooker Dan Sheehan at number eight, the first time he will have played there in a test match, though he has done so for his club Leinster.
The Springboks demolished the Ireland scrum when they won 24-13 in Dublin last year, but Kolisi is expecting a tougher battle this time round.
"Their scrum is much better than it was a year ago. You can see they're getting penalties," he said. "But our focus is not on what they're going to do. It's about making sure we stick to our plans and do what we need to do in the scrum."
Assistant coach Mzwandile Stick said Erasmus had been involved with the team during the week leading up to the game.
"He's been hands-on with our team, and we're in a good space," Stick said. "Irrespective of what has happened, we love him, we appreciate him, and no one is going to break us. I can tell you that for sure."

Source: Reuters

LONDON, Nov 20 : British-based digital bank OakNorth has secured a US banking charter, it said on Friday, the first such foreign online lender to win a broader banking licence in the world's biggest economy as it seeks to grow income.
OakNorth, which is backed by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners as well as Japan's SoftBank, will now be able to expand beyond lending to provide basic services such as checking and savings accounts.
The development shows how digital banks are increasingly diversifying worldwide as they seek to disrupt bricks-and-mortar incumbents, leaning on their lower cost base and more modern technology to win business from traditional lenders.
• OakNorth has bought Community Unity Bank in Michigan, it said on Friday, allowing it to provide a wider range of services as it builds its US business

This week, gamers in Saudi Arabia joined legions of fans around the world to play Grand Theft Auto VI upon launch — the first new release of the top-selling series since a Saudi ban was scrapped in 2025.
"Playing GTA VI in Saudi Arabia legally makes me so happy, because we're talking about a game that was banned," local content creator Thamer al Dairem said from a windowless, air-conditioned room, lit mostly by the bank of monitors displaying the game.
"We're talking about the biggest game in the world."

Support and investment in gaming by Saudi Arabia have been rising fast, not least from de facto ruler Mohammed bin Salman, often known by his initials MBS, who told Fox News in 2023 that gaming helped him disconnect and let off steam.
The Public Investment Fund (PIF), the sovereign wealth fund he chairs, owns a major stake worth over $2 billion in Take-Two Interactive, the US firm that owns Grand Theft Auto-developer Rockstar Games, LSEG Workspace data show.
CHANGING CUSTOMS IN CONSERVATIVE SAUDI ARABIA
In August, a consortium including PIF acquired gaming giant Electronic Arts for $55 billion. This month, gaming software provider Unity Software held talks with investors including the Saudi sovereign wealth fund on a potential buyout valuing it at around $25 billion.
PIF, which has spent the past year consolidating its gaming holdings into a subsidiary, Savvy Games Group, declined to comment.
MBS has been leading a campaign to open Saudi Arabia up and ease strict social and cultural norms that revolve around a conservative interpretation of Islam — a far cry from GTA VI's Vice City.
GTA VI advertisements have been appearing in some of Saudi Arabia's most popular shopping malls. One image shows the heroine wearing shorts and a crop top, her arm resting on her partner's shoulder — unthinkable a few years ago, when women were required to dress modestly and cover their hair.
MBS's wider reform plan, dubbed Vision 2030, is all about reducing reliance on oil and gas revenues, both in the economy and in state revenues, and PIF strategy is part of that.
"(It) is part of a diversified long-term investment strategy to capture value from industries it does not traditionally operate within," said Piers Harding-Rolls, who researches games at Ampere Analysis.
In Riyadh, al Dairem is now streaming Grand Theft Auto content and says that, while some of the depictions of violence, drugs and sex are extreme, the game is age-restricted and reflects another country.
"The city is Vice City, and it's representing Miami and the chaotic things that happen. For us Saudis, like, we know that it has nothing to do with us."
The gaming experience, on the other hand, matters hugely to him.
"When I saw the ads of GTA VI in the malls, I was so happy. If you'd asked me if I was ever going to see this, like, 10 years ago in Saudi, I wouldn't have believed it."

(Editing by Adam Jourdan and Kevin Liffey)

Source: Reuters

Nov 20 : Brighton and Hove Albion manager Fabian Huerzeler says his high-flying team must quickly re-focus as the Premier League resumes after the international break with the south coast club being billed as potential title contenders.
The stoppage interrupted an incredible start to the season for Brighton who have soared into second place behind defending champions Arsenal with 22 points from 10 games.
Brighton travel to Hull City on Sunday having won six of their last seven league games including a stunning 3-0 home drubbing of Arsenal and a victory at Manchester City.
They are the top flight's highest scorers with 26 goals and have conceded just seven, with only Arsenal leaking fewer, and according to Opta have an 8.45 per cent chance of pulling off the most surprising title grab since Leicester City in 2016.

Huerzeler knows momentum will be key if the Seagulls are to continue soaring.
"It's never easy (after the international break), but we managed it in the last period quite well and I hope we can manage it in this period as well," the German said.
"For us it is very important to really get the players understanding what our principles and values are here. They all hear different tactics and formations in their national teams and now it is about us giving them an understanding about what made us strong and what will make us strong in the future."
While Brighton have been free-scoring, all seven of their Premier League wins this season have come with clean sheets.
Huerzeler's intense pressing style has seen Brighton make a league-leading 106 high turnovers this season while they lead the way in chances converted and goals from set plays.
BASICS BEHIND BRIGHTON'S RISE
At 33, Huerzeler is the youngest manager in the Premier League, and while his methods have been lauded, he says Brighton's rise is rooted in basics.
"The game is evolving and I try to evolve things and adjust things. But ultimately football in the end is still like 20 years ago in terms of running, winning duels and counter pressing," he said.
"I wouldn't say we innovate or that I'm doing special things. I just try to be really good in the basics and develop my players with the staff."
German midfielder Pascal Gross has been a key figure this season and is finally getting the recognition he deserves with four goals and four assists in the Premier League.
He is set for his 300th appearance on Sunday.
"He gives everyone an understanding of what it means to be successful. He's a great standard and culture driver. That's his biggest impact," Huerzeler said.
Brighton will still be without Stefanos Tzimas, who is back in training after an ACL injury, while Japan winger Kaoru Mitoma is still "one or two weeks" from a return. Nigeria forward Zadok Yohanna will miss the Hull trip with a hamstring injury.

Source: Reuters

Nov 20 : Southampton coach Tonda Eckert has signed a new contract through 2029, the second-tier club said on Friday, despite uncertainty over his future following his role in the "spygate" scandal.
Eckert was handed a suspended six-week ban and fined £28,000 ($36,697) after admitting he authorised the observation of training sessions involving three rival Championship clubs last season.
The Football Association charged Eckert in July, with an independent regulatory commission imposing the sanctions after a hearing. The governing body confirmed in October that the ban would remain suspended until the end of the 2027-28 season.
"We've had some conversations that started a couple of weeks ago, and the goal was always clear: to show the same commitment we have had for the last 12 months," Eckert told the club website.

Eckert guided Southampton from 21st place to a fourth-placed finish last season. However, the club were thrown out of the Championship playoff final and docked four points for the 2026-27 campaign over the "spygate" affair.
Southampton, who are seventh in the Championship standings, host Derby County on Saturday.

By Meriem Tourabi
MADRID, Nov 20 (Reuters) – Spanish police used excessive force against protesters and journalists during last week’s general strike, rights group Amnesty International said on Friday.

• Amnesty said police used pepper spray, batons, tear gas and rubber bullets, and left 36 people injured, 5 of them hospitalised

• The NGO said it had documented incidents in Barcelona, Malaga, Valencia, Alicante and Granada, as well as Madrid, where it said demonstrators were not given any warning before police charged

Show Full Article

• Asked for comment by Reuters, the Interior Ministry pointed to its announcement the day after the strike that the use of pepper spray during demonstrations would be curbed

• Madrid police authorities on Thursday opened an internal investigation to assess officers’ actions in the capital

• Journalists were pushed and hit with batons while covering the strike, Amnesty said

• The group said its findings were based on interviews with 24 people. It called on authorities to carry out an “in-depth review of the protocols and rules that regulate police action at demonstrations”

(Reporting by Meriem Tourabi; Editing by David Latona and Andrew Heavens)

Nov 20 : PayPal named Xero's Claire Bramley as chief financial officer on Friday, succeeding Jamie Miller, in a broader shake-up of its senior leadership team as the payments firm pursues an ambitious turnaround.
Once a pandemic-era darling, PayPal has lost ground as consumers increasingly turn to payment services embedded in their smartphones, leaving its shares well below the record highs reached in 2021.
The shift has been amplified by the expansion of Big Tech into digital payments through services such as Google Pay and Apple Pay, chipping away at PayPal's market share and dampening investor confidence.
Bramley is set to join PayPal on February 1 from Xero, a global small-business platform, where she has served as CFO since April 2025.

"Notable leadership changes add another layer of complexity to PYPL's turnaround, with more organization disruption likely before potential benefits emerge," TD Cowen analysts wrote in a note.
"Thus, 2027 is set to be another transition year." PayPal shares were last down 3 per cent in morning trading.
In her new role, Bramley will be tasked with advancing the company's multi-year plan to streamline operations, cut costs and improve margins.
PayPal has set a goal of securing at least $1.5 billion in gross run-rate savings over the next two to three years.
The company has also tapped American Express' Kartik Mani as president and head of consumer financial services and Venmo — its flagship peer-to-peer payments platform.
Juan Rio is set to join PayPal from Brightstar.AI as executive vice-president of AI business transformation and operations at the end of November.
Accelerating AI adoption through the integration of AI and automation across PayPal's business accounts for about 40 per cent of its savings target.
PayPal currently has a market value of roughly $47 billion, versus its peak of about $360 billion in 2021.

items.title: Canada PR wait falls for parents, rises for Express Entry applicants
items.author: Surbhi Gloria Singh
items.summary: Canada's latest immigration data shows shorter permanent residence waiting times for parents' sponsorship applicants, while Express Entry applicants face a two-month increase ...
items.body: Canada has reduced waiting times for permanent residence (PR) applications in several categories, including provincial nominee and parents’ sponsorship programmes, according to the latest data released by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) on November 17. However, not all applicants have seen shorter waits. Processing times for skilled workers applying through the Federal Skilled Worker Program (FSWP) have increased by two months, while those sponsoring their spouses are also facing longer waits. The Canadian Experience Class (CEC) processing time remained unchanged at six months, while applicants under the base Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) saw waiting times fall by one month to 12 months. The Parents and Grandparents Program (PGP) recorded a reduction of two months for applicants outside Quebec and three months for those intending to settle in the province. For applicants already in Canada who are waiting for a decision on their PR applications, a Bridging Open Work Permit (BOWP) may allow them to continue working. Those who apply before their existing work permit expires may benefit from maintained status, allowing them to work under the same conditions while their application is being processed. Canada PR processing times: Economic immigration Waiting times across most economic immigration programmes either fell or remained unchanged. The Federal Skilled Worker Program was the main exception, with processing times increasing by two months. Express Entry Processing times for the FSWP increased from seven months to nine months. The number of pending applications also rose by 1,800 to 60,100. The Canadian Experience Class (CEC), meanwhile, continued to have a six-month processing time, even as its pending applications fell by 5,700 to 48,200. Processing times (November 17; previous update: October 9): Canadian Experience Class (CEC): 6 months; unchanged.Federal Skilled Worker Program (FSWP): 9 months; up from 7 months.Federal Skilled Trades Program (FSTP): Not available in both updates. Service standard: Six months for all Express Entry programmes. Applications awaiting assessment: CEC: 48,200, down 5,700.FSWP: 60,100, up 1,800. Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) Applicants under the base PNP category saw processing times fall by one month to 12 months. The number of pending applications also declined by 6,300 to 90,200. For applicants applying through the Express Entry-linked enhanced PNP stream, the waiting period remained unchanged at seven months. Its pending applications increased by 700 to 13,800. Processing times (November 17; previous update: October 9): Enhanced PNP (through Express Entry): 7 months; unchanged.Base PNP (through non-Express Entry): 12 months; down from 13 months. Service standards: Six months for enhanced PNP applications and 11 months for base PNP applications. Applications awaiting assessment: Enhanced PNP: 13,800, up 700.Base PNP: 90,200, down 6,300. Under a temporary federal measure introduced on June 9, 2026, eligible PNP applicants can apply for a BOWP without waiting to receive an Acknowledgement of Receipt (AOR) for their PR application. Quebec immigration Processing times for the Quebec Business Class (QBC) fell by two months to 73 months. The Skilled Worker Selection Program (PSTQ), however, remained unchanged at 11 months. The number of pending PSTQ applications declined by 400 to 20,100, while the QBC inventory remained unchanged at 3,600. Processing times (November 17; previous update: October 9): Skilled Worker Selection Program (PSTQ): 11 months; unchanged.Quebec Business Class (QBC): 73 months; down from 75 months. Service standards: Six months for PSTQ applicants. No service standard is published for QBC applications. Applications awaiting assessment: PSTQ: 20,100, down 400.QBC: 3,600, unchanged. Atlantic Immigration Program Processing times under the Atlantic Immigration Program (AIP) fell by one month to 25 months. The number of applications awaiting assessment also declined by 400 to 11,100. Processing time (November 17; previous update: October 9): Atlantic Immigration Program: 25 months, down from 26 months. Service standard: 11 months. Applications awaiting assessment: 11,100, down 400. Other economic immigration programmes Applicants under the Start-Up Visa (SUV) and Federal Self-Employed Persons Program (FSEPP) continued to face estimated waiting times of more than 10 years. The SUV inventory fell marginally by 100 applications to 47,400, while the FSEPP backlog remained unchanged at 8,000. Processing times (November 17; previous update: October 9): Start-Up Visa (SUV): More than 10 years; unchanged.Federal Self-Employed Persons Program (FSEPP): More than 10 years; unchanged. Service standards: Not available for these programmes. Applications awaiting assessment: SUV: 47,400, down 100.FSEPP: 8,000, unchanged. Canada PR processing times: Family sponsorship Family sponsorship applicants saw mixed changes in the latest update. Waiting times for spouses and common-law partners increased by one month across all categories, while the Parents and Grandparents Program recorded shorter waiting periods. Sponsorship outside Quebec Processing times for sponsoring a spouse or common-law partner increased by one month, whether the partner was living in Canada or abroad. In contrast, the waiting period under the PGP fell by two months to 26 months. The number of applications awaiting assessment under this programme also declined by 1,800 to 33,800. Processing times (November 17; previous update: October 9): Spouse or common-law partner living in Canada: 27 months, up from 26 months.Spouse or common-law partner living outside Canada: 19 months, up from 18 months.Parents and Grandparents Program (PGP): 26 months, down from 28 months. Service standard: 12 months for sponsoring a spouse or common-law partner outside Quebec. No service standards are published for the other categories. Applications awaiting assessment: Partner living in Canada: 55,100, down 500.Partner living outside Canada: 65,900, up 300.Parents and Grandparents: 33,800, down 1,800. Sponsorship within Quebec Applicants sponsoring spouses or common-law partners who intend to settle in Quebec also faced a one-month increase in processing times. The PGP recorded a three-month reduction, with the estimated waiting period falling to 60 months. Processing times (November 17; previous update: October 9): Spouse or common-law partner living in Canada: 33 months, up from 32 months.Spouse or common-law partner living outside Canada: 34 months, up from 33 months.Parents and Grandparents Program: 60 months, down from 63 months. Service standards: IRCC does not publish service standards for family sponsorship applications involving applicants intending to settle in Quebec. Applications awaiting assessment: Partner living in Canada: 14,700, up 200.Partner living outside Canada: 19,700, up 300.Parents and Grandparents: 10,100, down 200. Canada citizenship processing times Processing times for most citizenship-related applications remained unchanged in the November update. The waiting period for a citizenship grant remained at 12 months, in line with IRCC's service standard. Applications for renunciation of citizenship continued to take four months. The processing time for searches of citizenship records improved by one month to 18 months. Processing times (November 17; previous update: October 9): Citizenship grant: 12 months; unchanged.Renunciation of citizenship: 4 months; unchanged.Search of citizenship records: 18 months, down from 19 months. Service standard: 12 months for citizenship grants. IRCC reported 322,900 citizenship grant applications in its November update, an increase of 200 from October 9.

MADRID, Nov 20 (Reuters) – Spain’s High Court has released pro-Palestinian donor and US media heir James Cox Chambers Jr. on conditional bail, while it considers an extradition request by the United States, according to a court ruling released on Friday.

The court said it had decided to release Chambers after US authorities acknowledged what they described as substantial and unintentional errors in the Spanish translation of an FBI agent’s sworn statement submitted in support of the extradition request.

Chambers, whose family owns Cox Enterprises, was arrested at the request of US authorities on July 10 while on holiday in Ibiza. He has been held in custody since on accusations including riot, conspiracy to commit riot and international money laundering. Chambers, known as Fergie, denies wrongdoing.

Show Full Article

After a hearing last week, the court had been expected to rule on the extradition request in the coming weeks, but it said on Friday that the translation errors could delay a final decision.

Judges said the issue could be relevant to the outcome of the proceedings because it raised questions about the accuracy of documents provided by US authorities and could weaken, at least temporarily, the basis for the extradition request.

Chambers must report weekly to a local court, surrender his passport, remain in Spain, provide an address and appear before the High Court whenever summoned.

The case is politically sensitive for Spain’s Socialist-led government, whose strong pro-Palestinian stance has drawn criticism from the administration of US President Donald Trump and added to wider tensions with Washington. 

If the court approves the extradition, Spain’s cabinet will make the final decision.

Separately, Chambers’ lawyers said they were challenging a raid by Irish police on his family home in Dublin, which they said was conducted at the request of US authorities and involved the seizure of electronic devices and other property. His legal team said it would seek judicial review unless authorities clarify the legal basis for the operation. 

(Reporting by Emma Pinedo, additional reporting by Kate Holton, editing by Andrei Khalip and Sharon Singleton)

Dollar falls as Fed-fueled rally stalls; lower US yields help yen

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 20 : The dollar fell broadly on Friday as a weeks-long rally fueled by bets on a hawkish Federal Reserve lost momentum, but waning appetite for riskier currencies limited the losses.
The dollar index fell 0.2 per cent to 103.75, just short of the 103.9 level it touched in the previous session, its highest since April 2025. The index was on track to snap an eight-session winning streak and is up 1.7 per cent so far this month.
The dollar's rally accelerated on November 10, when hotter-than-expected US inflation data reinforced bets that the Fed would tighten policy and Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a 50-basis-point hike in December should be considered.
"I think the momentum has stalled for the dollar ... but I think it's a little bit early to pick a top for the dollar," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets.

US Treasury yields dropped on Friday as a multitude of AI-related concerns weighed on global stocks and Anthropic's record market debut on Thursday did little to revive investor confidence. On Friday, investors sought out safe-haven assets. Lower Treasury yields also boosted the relative appeal of the Swiss franc. The dollar slipped 0.5 per cent against the franc.
"When US rates are falling, low-yielding currencies look better," Chandler said.
Still, strategists see the dollar continuing to draw some support from the outlook for a hawkish Fed.
Chris Turner, global head of markets at ING, said that while there is only a weak case for another steep correction in equities, "there is no reason for the Fed to drop its hawkish rhetoric anytime soon."
 He pointed to the release next week of the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index, a key inflation gauge for the Fed, which Turner said will likely confirm that the US central bank needs to act.
"For FX, that means a continued strong dollar and continued pressure on popular carry trades," he said.
In FX carry trades, investors borrow in low-yielding currencies, such as the Japanese yen and Swiss franc, to fund purchases of higher-yielding assets elsewhere, often in emerging markets.
YEN FIRMS ON INFLATION DATA
Against the yen, the dollar slipped 0.5 per cent to 158.85, still close to levels at which Japanese authorities intervened in July to shore up the drooping currency.
"The yen has jumped today, helped by lower US rates and firm Japanese October CPI," Chandler said.
Japan's annual core inflation accelerated to 2.2 per cent in October, staying above the central bank's 2 per cent target for a second straight month and pointing to broadening price pressures that strengthen the case for a near-term rate hike by the Bank of Japan.
Analysts at Capital Economics argue that the yen's recent weakness is unlikely to last. With long-term inflation expectations now around target, further increases in yields would be mostly in real terms, which, combined with their view that US yields will fall, should prove yen-positive, the analysts said.
Meanwhile, sterling rose 0.1 per cent, but remained near a one-year low against the dollar at $1.31065.
In cryptocurrency markets, bitcoin slipped to a fresh four-month low as investors avoided riskier investments. Bitcoin was last trading roughly flat on the day at $61,442.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ロシア、キーウの橋3カ所など各地を攻撃　ウクライナ全土で8人死亡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Valentyn Ogirenko　Lina Golovnya

[キーウ ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Valentyn Ogirenko　Lina Golovnya

[キーウ ２０日 ロイター] - ロシア軍は２０日未明にかけて、ウクライナの首都キーウの３つの橋をミサイルで攻撃した。ウクライナ当局によると、一連の攻撃で首都で６人、その他の地域で２人が死亡した。ロシアのプーチン大統領は前日、クリミア半島につながる橋へのウクライナの攻撃に対し報復を表明していた。

ドニプロ川に架かるキーウの東西を結ぶ３つの橋への攻撃は、ロシアによる２０２２年２月の侵攻開始以降、橋を狙った攻撃として最大規模となった。首都で爆発音が響く中、住民は地下鉄に避難した。当局によると、ロシア軍はウクライナ各地の電力インフラも攻撃し、広範囲で停電が発生した。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがドローン（無人機）４００機超と１１０発以上のミサイルを発射し、ウクライナ全土のエネルギー、物流、鉄道インフラを標的にしたと述べた。ミサイル２７発は弾道ミサイルだった。

今年は前線での進軍がほぼ停滞する中、双方は空からの攻撃を強化している。ウクライナはロシア各地の製油所を激しく攻撃し、ロシアはウクライナの電力インフラや輸送・補給網などを標的としている。

ゼレンスキー氏は通信アプリ「テレグラム」に「今回の攻撃は最大規模の一つだった」と投稿。「プーチン氏は、見せつけるように今回の攻撃を仕掛けた。ロシアは軍事・外交面での無力さを、テロ行為、命を狙う攻撃によって埋め合わせようとしている」と述べた。

キーウのクリチコ市長は通信アプリ「テレグラム」で、ポディルスキー・ボスクレセンスキー橋、ダルニツキー橋、ピウデンニー橋が攻撃を受けたと明らかにし、車での通勤を控えるよう住民に呼び掛けた。

戦争開始前は首都の人口３００万人のうち３分の１超がドニプロ川の東岸に当たる「左岸」に住んでいたが、その多くは政府機関や企業が集中する西岸の「右岸」で働いている。

キーウで６人が死亡したほか、西部リビウの鉄道駅でも２人の死亡が報告された。

プーチン氏は１９日、クリミア半島とロシアのクラスノダール地方を結ぶ橋がウクライナにより今週３度攻撃を受けたことを受け報復を表明。ウクライナは数カ月にわたり、ロシアの補給網を狙った攻撃を続けている。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、橋への攻撃はウクライナのインフラに対するロシアによる攻撃への報復だと説明している。

キーウ当局によると、水道施設への攻撃で職員３人が死亡し、市内４地区で水圧が低下した。一部の建物では一時的に断水する可能性があるという。

送電会社によると、西部のリビウ、ザカルパッチャ、イワノフランキウスクの各州で緊急停電措置を導入。キーウでは５地区で一部の電力供給が途絶えた。

ウクライナ国鉄は、ロシアの攻撃により複数の地域で鉄道インフラが損傷したと明らかにした。

リビウ州当局によると、リビウのスクニリウ駅への攻撃で２人が死亡し、少なくとも７人が負傷した。

南東部ドニプロペトロウシク州では集合住宅へのドローン攻撃で５人が負傷。ウクライナ第２の都市ハルキウでも、ドローンが病院を直撃し４人が負傷した。

ポーランドでは夜間にミサイル２基とドローンとみられるロシアからの飛行物体が国境に近い南東部の空域に侵入、航空機が緊急発進した。ウクライナとの国境付近に落下したとみられている。

items.title: エストニア、対ロ国境を少なくとも6カ月閉鎖へ　ロは対抗措置警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ビリニュス　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ビリニュス　２０日　ロイター] - エストニア政府は２０日、安全保障上の理由から、１２月１日から少なくとも６カ月間、ロシアとの国境検問所を閉鎖すると発表した。これを受けてロシア政府は、政治・外交的措置で対抗すると警告した。

エストニアは国内の防衛企業で放火とみられる事件が起きたことを受け、１２月からロシアとの全ての国境検問所を閉鎖すると発表していたが、閉鎖期間は明らかにしていなかった。この攻撃はロシアによるものだとしている。ロシア政府は関与を否定している。

タロ内相は記者会見で、閉鎖はより広範な安全保障上の状況への対処につながり、ロシアがさらなる攻撃を仕掛ける能力を制限するのに役立つとの考えを示し、「ロシアの治安機関は、国境検問所を通過するわが国の市民を威嚇し、勧誘しようとしている。これはもはや容認できない」と述べた。

政府は声明で「今回の決定は、エストニアや他の欧州諸国に対してロシアが続けている敵対行為への対応だ」と説明した。「エストニアでは今年、防衛産業の企業が２度攻撃された。国内治安機関によると、いずれもロシアの特殊機関が指示した」と述べた。

これに対し、ロシア外務省のザハロワ報道官は２０日、エストニアが国境閉鎖に踏み切れば、ロシアは政治・外交的措置で対抗すると表明。「こうした動きは、東方からの何らかの脅威という偽りの口実のもと、新たな鉄のカーテンを築こうとする試みに等しい」と述べた。

エストニアの北に位置するフィンランドは、２０２３年にロシアとの国境検問所を閉鎖し、それ以降封鎖状態を維持している。一方、バルト三国南部のラトビアとリトアニアは国境検問所を開放したままにしている。

Nov 20 : Alphabet has raised C$6 billion ($4.19 billion) through a four-tranche Canadian bond offering, according to a pricing term sheet filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday.
Big technology companies are increasingly tapping debt markets and raising equity to bolster AI infrastructure, marking a shift from their traditional reliance on cash to fund investments.
The money raised would be used for general corporate purposes, which could include repayment of outstanding debt, the Google parent said in the filing.
Alphabet expects to receive about C$5.97 billion after underwriting discounts, or bank fees, and before expenses. The offering was priced on November 19 and is scheduled to settle on November 24.

The notes are senior unsecured debt and have received a rating of Aa2 with a "stable" outlook from Moody's, and AA+ with a "stable" outlook from S&P, the filing showed.
RBC Dominion Securities, Scotia Capital and TD Securities are joint book-running managers for the transaction, while CIBC World Markets is a co-manager.
Big Tech rival Meta in October announced plans for its largest-ever equity offerings of around $97.5 billion, including stock sales of about $37.5 billion, and plans to later raise up to $60 billion through an at-the-market share-sale program, or a plan to sell shares into the market over time at prevailing prices.
Alphabet had increased its equity offerings to $84.75 billion in June. Last month, the company reported negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion in the third quarter, versus analysts' expectation that it would come close to breaking even.

BANGKOK, Nov 20 : Thailand must keep the United States as a major trade partner and cannot lose it to its competitors, its Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Friday, as his government defended a trade deal with Washington.
• Thailand and the United States this week signed a joint statement about a "substantial conclusion" to negotiations on reciprocal trade
• Opening Thailand's market to more US goods does not require government purchases, but would give private importers another source for products, Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun told a briefing
• Thailand is in talks with Washington to cut a US tariff to 10 per cent from 12.5 per cent, she said

• The country should not face less favourable terms than neighbouring countries that have signed reciprocal trade agreements with the US, as a widening tariff gap could hurt exports and employment, she said
• The US is Thailand's largest export market, with exports worth about 2.37 trillion baht ($69.81 billion) in 2025 and linked to around 1.25 million jobs, the commerce ministry said
• The joint statement is not the final agreement, with a legal review, a signing and some domestic procedures still to be completed before it takes effect, Suphajee said
• Thailand will not allow imports of US pork containing ractopamine, the commerce ministry said
($1 = 33.95 baht)

Astronomers observe a huge puffy star merge with smaller companion

Observations from NASA's James Webb Space Telescope in December 2025 provide the final evidence that allows researchers to reconstruct the merger of a binary star system nicknamed Bao in the Andromeda Galaxy, in an image released November 18, 2026. FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 20 : Astronomers have observed a large dying star, seven times more massive and 18,000 times brighter than the sun, engulfing a smaller companion in a stellar merger unlike any other previously witnessed.
The merger involved a pair of stars that were bound gravitationally — known as a binary system — in which the larger one greatly expanded in its death throes into what is called a puffy supergiant and enveloped the smaller one, with the two stars then combining into one.
This cosmic connection occurred about 2.5 million light-years from Earth on the outskirts of the Andromeda Galaxy, one of our Milky Way's closest galactic neighbors. A light-year is the distance light travels in a year, 5.9 trillion miles (9.5 trillion km).
The researchers identified the impending engulfment nearly three years before it occurred and then watched as the merger unfolded, step by step.

"Giant stars engulfing their companion stars have been theorized for many decades, and understanding the outcomes of this process has important implications for explaining a wide range of systems that we see today in the universe," said Viraj Karambelkar, a postdoctoral researcher and NASA Hubble Fellow at Columbia University in New York, lead author of the research published in the journal Nature.
"The system presented in this study provides the first direct observations of this process happening — the first time a giant star engulfing its companion was caught in the act," Karambelkar said.
Large stars near the end of their lifespan can swell up as their cores run out of fuel and shrink while the inner stellar heat pushes the outer layers outward. The larger star in this study puffed up to 350 times the sun's diameter. The smaller star, whose diameter was about 70 per cent that of the sun, orbited its companion at roughly the same distance as between Mars and the sun, and was engulfed in the bigger star's expansion.
'SET OFF A BOMB'
The researchers detected brightening when this occurred in 2018, and the smaller star began to spiral inward toward the core of the bigger star over the next seven years. Toward the end of 2025, the smaller star finally merged with the core of the larger one, triggering an eruption a million times brighter than the sun in what Karambelkar called "a unification event."
"This violent collision set off a bomb inside the star, producing the bright eruption that we saw," Karambelkar said.
The researchers first spotted the stars using data from the infrared WINTER telescope at Palomar Observatory in California and NASA's NEOWISE space telescope, then watched the events with the orbiting SPHEREx and James Webb space telescopes and various ground-based observatories.
"We have observed mergers of stars in the past," said Columbia astrophysics professor and study co-author Kishalay De.
"The difference is in the nature of the stars that merged. In the past, stellar mergers were observed from two stars that were fairly small and compact, and their merger was almost inevitable once they came into physical contact. However, the bigger star in this event was a very puffed-up star where its outer envelope was loosely bound. This configuration is exactly the kind in which a merger may or may not happen," De said.
In some cases, an engulfed smaller star might release enough energy to blow away the larger star's puffy outer layers, leaving behind the remaining core of the original bigger star orbiting the smaller one, De said.
While the larger of the two stars in this instance was nearing the end of its life, the merger may have produced a rejuvenated star with a new lease on life, the researchers said.
The researchers gave the merged star the nickname Bao, the name of popular steamed buns in Chinese cuisine.
"The auto-assigned name to this eruption was AT2025abao — 'Astronomical Transient in 2025 abao.' We called it Bao as an affectionate term derived from this. The similarity with the Chinese buns definitely encouraged us to adopt the nickname," Karambelkar said.

Source: Reuters

items.author: CNA

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 20 : Artificial intelligence has sped up early-stage drug development work at some of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies this year, cutting by as much as half the time it takes to produce new molecules and move them into the clinic, according to their top scientists.
GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb, Novartis, Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, AstraZeneca and Sanofi all say they have moved beyond less glamorous tasks for AI like preparing regulatory filings. They are now using the technology for designing molecules, sorting out the most promising ones, and identifying safety risks.
“There is no part of the discovery through development pipeline where we are not using AI,” AstraZeneca executive Sharon Barr said.
Some of the scientists say decades of drug discovery experience and data give them an advantage over AI companies like Anthropic, which is gearing up to be a rival, partner or both, with a $1.5 trillion initial public offering this week.

In recent months, it opened its own laboratory and announced other investments, part of pushing AI to speed drug discovery.
On Thursday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, at the Nasdaq before shares began trading, spoke of his father dying of a disease shortly before a cure was found.
Although clinical trials and experiments will still take time, he said, "I believe these processes can be substantially accelerated by AI. We hope that in the future, fewer families miss a cure by a few years."
Drug companies are gauging whether the upstart can succeed in tackling disease. Historically, nearly 9 out of 10 drugs developed using conventional methods fail in clinical trials. It can cost billions of dollars and take 10 to 15 years to bring a drug to market, according to industry lobby group PhRMA.
Aliza Apple, who runs Lilly's TuneLab, which gives smaller biotechs access to some of the drugmaker's internal AI models to promote collaboration, said claims like those made by Amodei and the founders of Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs that the technology is capable of curing all disease overstate current capabilities.
“It would be great for them to cure one, and then let's talk about the rest,” she said.
CONCRETE RESULTS
Pharma company scientists say their AI programs are already yielding concrete results.
Sanofi said it saved at least a year developing asthma treatment lunsekimig using an AI-enabled approach to translate early biology into clinical decisions that let the company skip a dose-selection study. Novartis said AI tools helped it find five targets it prioritized for developing kidney disease treatments.
Bristol Myers said one of its sickle cell anemia candidates would not have been developed without the company's AI systems. It's using AI to refine new molecules and run simulations based on its trial data to determine which ones should progress, Chief Research Officer Robert Plenge said.
"The next area for us is to tie those models into laboratory automation... to make better, high-quality molecules faster,” he added.
Novo Nordisk said AI has cut the number of cycles of designing, manufacturing and testing new molecules from around eight to three and slashed the time of each cycle from eight weeks to four.
Still, the number of AI-enabled drugs in clinical testing has only climbed incrementally. In March, researchers identified 129 drug candidates across 69 companies, up from around 117 eight months earlier. Most of the programs remain in early-stage development.
“I think over the next 1, 2, 3 years we'll see a sharp uptick in AI drugs being developed pre-clinically and also drugs that go to clinical trials,” said Dr. Waqas Haque, an oncology fellow at University of Chicago who was on the team that compiled the data.
“I don't know if those drugs are going to be more successful than non-AI drugs, and I don't think they're going to be approved any quicker,” he said, because of bottlenecks with human trials and regulators.
'JUST THE BEGINNING'
Anthropic's Amodei has long said curing disease is one of the main benefits AI can provide to humanity.
The company is working on its own and with partners like Bristol Myers to develop new drugs. It launched scientific research-focused AI software called Claude Science, and added Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan to its board. Other companies, including Novo Nordisk, use Anthropic models and Claude Science in their R&D work.
Luca Giani, senior principal at venture capital firm Alumni Ventures, said Anthropic — and rival frontier labs — are shopping for pharma-related acquisitions.
"They are out to get more data, and they are out to get more of the companies," Giani said.
Anthropic did not respond to a request for comment on its acquisition plans and the nature of its relationship with drugmakers.
Even before its $1.5 trillion IPO, Anthropic announced several partnerships and an acquisition last month, he said.
"I think it's just the beginning."
Lilly’s Apple said Anthropic and AI rivals can be viewed as allies and competitors.
“In the early days, we certainly saw them as vendors. To be fair, that's how they framed themselves. I think we increasingly see them as collaborators,” Apple said. “A year ago they weren't doing any programs, and a year from now, it's anyone's guess.”
GSK Chief Scientific Officer Tony Wood said he views Anthropic “as another competitor,” while Bristol Myers and Novo see the AI companies more as partners.
Still, Novo said it does not provide proprietary data to frontier labs to train their AI models, nor does Sanofi.
“If you don’t have the data to train the model on, then it breaks down very quickly,” said Matt Truppo, global head of computational & AI strategy for Sanofi R&D.
Truppo said he expects AI to cut early-discovery timelines by 20 per cent to 25 per cent within two years, and perhaps by half within five years, across more than 100 drug development programs.
It may be some time before this can be expanded beyond treatment areas where the company has the most proprietary data, he added.
Novartis President of Biomedical Research Fiona Marshall said the average time from project start to a drug candidate has gone from three years to about 18 months to two years.
“We have had a lot of data," Marshall said, "and now we can really use that data in a much more sophisticated way.”

Source: Reuters

items.title: ＳＫハイニックス、社債転換でキオクシアの筆頭株主へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２０日 ロイター] - 韓国半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスは、１２月に投資ビークルの社債を株式に転換することで、キオクシアホールディングスの筆頭株主となる。

ＳＫハイニックスは、当該社債を１２万９０００株の普通株に転換し、さらにベイン・キャピタルから株式１００１株を追加購入すると発表。この取引により、キオクシアの株式を間接的に約１４．１％保有することになる。

また、現時点でキオクシア株の追加売買の計画はなく、本取引後もキオクシアの経営への関与は限定的なものにとどまると述べた。

調査会社カウンターポイントによると、ＳＫハイニックスはＮＡＮＤチップ市場でシェア１９％を占める第２位のメーカーであり、キオクシアはシェア１４％で第４位にランクされている。

２０１８年、ＳＫハイニックスはベイン・キャピタルが主導するコンソーシアムに計３９５０億円を投じ、同コンソーシアムは東芝メモリ（現キオクシア）を買収した。

キオクシアが２４年１２月に東京証券取引所に上場した後、ベインが管理する投資ビークルは６月に保有するキオクシア株の全株売却を完了した。

ＳＫハイニックス、社債転換でキオクシアの筆頭株主へ
11/20 19:43 配信

ＳＫハイニックスのロゴ REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） [ソウル ２０日 ロイター] - 韓国半導体大手ＳＫハイニックスは、１２月に投資ビークルの社債を株式に転換することで、キオクシアホールディングスの筆頭株主となる。

ＳＫハイニックスは、当該社債を１２万９０００株の普通株に転換し、さらにベイン・キャピタルから株式１００１株を追加購入すると発表。この取引により、キオクシアの株式を間接的に約１４．１％保有することになる。

また、現時点でキオクシア株の追加売買の計画はなく、本取引後もキオクシアの経営への関与は限定的なものにとどまると述べた。

調査会社カウンターポイントによると、ＳＫハイニックスはＮＡＮＤチップ市場でシェア１９％を占める第２位のメーカーであり、キオクシアはシェア１４％で第４位にランクされている。

２０１８年、ＳＫハイニックスはベイン・キャピタルが主導するコンソーシアムに計３９５０億円を投じ、同コンソーシアムは東芝メモリ（現キオクシア）を買収した。

キオクシアが２４年１２月に東京証券取引所に上場した後、ベインが管理する投資ビークルは６月に保有するキオクシア株の全株売却を完了した。

FAST

Nov 20 : Anthropic's much-hyped arrival on Wall Street fizzled out on Friday, as a dramatic unraveling of the AI trade showed that even a blockbuster listing could not shake the gloom hanging over the sector.
Widely seen as a proxy for the AI trade, Anthropic's listing had been viewed as a potential boost for an industry struggling to regain its footing after a turbulent stretch.
But the stock was last trading at $88.24, about 9 per cent below Thursday's close, while losses across other technology heavyweights suggested the IPO had done little to reverse the broader selloff.
"Investors still believe in AI but are becoming more selective about what they will pay for that growth," said David Miller, chief investment officer at Catalyst Funds.

Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Nvidia and Meta Platforms fell more than 3 per cent each, while Amazon and Microsoft dropped 2 per cent and 1 per cent, respectively.
Chip stocks also slid, with AMD and Sandisk down over 6 per cent each and Intel losing more than 3 per cent.
The focus now shifts to a potential OpenAI listing, which would be another major test of investors' appetite for AI stocks. OpenAI has indicated it may go public next year.
Despite a pipeline of high-profile AI and infrastructure companies, many have pushed their IPO plans to 2027.
PATIENCE MAY PAY
Anthropic's stock could find support later in the year. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates index-tracking funds could account for purchases of up to 30 per cent of Anthropic's shares by year-end.
Near-term volatility, however, could persist as the initial euphoria around the listing fades and investors assess whether a valuation of about 40 times sales over the past 12 months can be sustained.
"We favor patience on Anthropic and recommend evaluating the company as it reports public results," said Kaush Amin, head of private market investing at US Bank Asset Management, adding that the current valuation "assumes years of rapid growth."
The debut has also done little to ease broader concerns about the health of the AI trade. Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Thursday, while futures pointed to further declines on Friday.
PARALLELS WITH SPACEX
Anthropic's IPO has drawn parallels with Elon Musk's SpaceX, which went public in June after the second-biggest IPO on record.
Anthropic raised $93.5 billion in its IPO after underwriters exercised an option to buy additional shares, surpassing SpaceX's $85.7 billion haul to become the biggest listing on record.
While the companies have different business models, some investors have pointed to SpaceX's sharp swings in the weeks after its debut as a reason for caution over buying Anthropic immediately after its listing.
"There's going to be some volatility like we had with SpaceX. A lot of people are going to have FOMO. I don't think there's any need to get on it on the first trade," said Rob Hackel, CEO of financial advisory and brokerage firm RF Lafferty & Co.
SpaceX shares fell more than 6 per cent.
Retail investors traded about $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012.
The stock's sharp swings have left investors weighing whether to bet on a rebound or brace for further losses. Options trading, due to begin next week, could add to the volatility.
"It's not a good environment for Anthropic at the moment," said Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Berenberg.

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２０日 ロイター] - ミャンマー治安部隊によるイスラム系少数民族ロヒンギャへの迫害を国際司法裁判所（ＩＣＪ）がジェノサイド（集団虐殺）と認定したことについて、ミャンマー政府報道官は２０日、判決は不公正だと批判した。

首都ネピドーでの記者会見で「わが国は不当に非難された」と語った。「この判決は全会一致の判断ではなく、公正ではない」と述べた。

判決への対応を問われ、世界の主要な指導者らが以前、ＩＣＪのような「政治機関」は「司法権を乱用すべきではない」と述べていたと語った。

ＩＣＪがジェノサイドについて国家の責任を認めたのは初めて。裁判官らは、ミャンマー軍がロヒンギャの男性や少年を大量処刑し、女性に対し広範にわたって性暴力を行い、数百の村を焼き払ったり破壊したりしたと認定した。

判決はミャンマーにはロヒンギャに補償する義務があり、補償内容は後日決定されるとした。また、ミャンマーの「不法行為」によって避難を余儀なくされたロヒンギャの「安全で尊厳ある帰還」を認めなければならないとした。

SEOUL, Nov 20 : South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix Inc will become the largest shareholder in Japanese rival Kioxia Holdings by converting bonds of an investment vehicle into shares in December.
SK Hynix said it would convert the bonds into 129,000 common shares and buy 1,001 additional shares in the entity from Bain Capital, a transaction that will give SK Hynix an indirect stake of about 14.1 per cent in Kioxia.
SK Hynix also said it had no current plans to buy or sell additional Kioxia shares and its participation in Kioxia's management would remain limited after the deal.
The plan comes amid robust demand for NAND chips, used for storage in devices ranging from smartphones to servers in AI data centers.

SK Hynix is the No.2 maker of NAND chips, with a 19 per cent share, while Kioxia ranks fourth with a 14 per cent share, according to research firm Counterpoint.
In 2018, SK Hynix invested a total of 395 billion yen ($2.48 billion) in the Bain Capital-led consortium that acquired Toshiba Memory, now Kioxia.
A Bain-managed investment vehicle completed the sale of all of its Kioxia shares in June, after Kioxia listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in December 2024.

items.body:
[台北 ２０日 ロイター] - 台湾証券取引所の林修銘董事長は２０日、株価が再び急落する中、資本市場の安定的な運営を確保すると述べ、投資家は台湾企業のファンダメンタルズ（基礎的条件）に対して引き続き自信を持つべきだと訴えた。

ハイテク銘柄が中心の同証取は、ＡＩ（人工知能）ブームの将来に対する不安に揺らいでおり、２０日の主要株価指数は６％以上急落し、週間ベースで３０年以上ぶりに最悪のパフォーマンスを記録した。

林氏は声明で、台湾の資本市場は国際市場と密接に結びついており、短期的には国際的な政治・経済情勢や市場心理の影響を免れることはできないと指摘。しかし、台湾は堅調な経済ファンダメンタルズを有しており、ＡＩコンピューティングに対する世界的な需要には、中長期的に成長の余地が依然として残っていると述べた。

金融監督当局がすでに新たな空売り規制を導入しており、取引所も引き続き市場状況を注視していると説明。所管当局と連携して必要に応じて措置の見直しや調整を行うと付け加えた。
